row.name: A+ Kidz Care Learning Center  LLC

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: The director completed CPR training online without the use of a CPR manikin.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Employee Assignments: Based on information gathered, the director did not ensure the caregiver's job assignment matched their abilities.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Employee Assignments (26 TAC §746.1003(3))

occurrences.finding: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions: At the time of inspection a provisional caregiver was left alone with children which violates conditions on the background.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions (26 TAC §745.635(3))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: During the course of an investigation, it was determined that two caregivers feel asleep during naptime leaving children unsupervised.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation: Documentation for one caregiver's orientation could not be located at the time of the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(1)(A))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Caring for children under 24 months: The director could not locate her current SIDS/Shaken Baby Training during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Caring for children under 24 months (26 TAC §746.1311(d))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: A shelf that posed a tipping hazard was not secured to the wall. This resulted in the shelf tipping over onto a child, causing an injury to the child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Two outlet plate covers were broken. A carpet in the school age room was observed stained.    Note: This was corrected when the carpet was removed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes: An infant was observed in a restrictive device for more than fifteen minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes (26 TAC §746.2417(2)(B))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on information provided during a DFPS investigation and audio provided, caregivers failed to use good judgement where talking negatively and about personal matters regarding children/families in front of the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: Based on information gathered during a DFPS investigation and audio provided, caregivers are heard yelling at the children repeatedly throughout the day.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment: Based on information gathered during a DFPS investigation and audio provided, a caregiver is heard threatening a child to lay down or they would get a "pow pow."
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))

occurrences.finding: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk: The operation failed to notify the parent of a child who was found alone in the operation's parking lot, placing the child at risk of significant harm.  The parent was not notified until late the following day that their child was subject of an investigation regarding possible neglectful supervision.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk (26 TAC §746.307(b)(4))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Operation staff failed to adequately supervise a child in care, resulting in that child pushing their way through a gate and exiting the playground into the parking lot.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The operational policies lacked complete information regarding promotion of indoor and outdoor physical activity.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Entanglement Protrusions or Openings: The school aged playground's volleyball net was torn and hanging down, posing a risk to children.     Note: This was corrected when the net was removed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Entanglement Protrusions or Openings (26 TAC §746.4601(4))

occurrences.finding: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion: One out of ten personnel records evaluated lacked documentation of high school diploma or a graduation date.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion (26 TAC §746.1107(2))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors -   Pediatric first aid with rescue breathing: One out of ten personnel records evaluated lacked documentation of current First Aid and CPR training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors -   Pediatric first aid with rescue breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations: Two out of ten children's files evaluated lacked documentation of current immunizations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations (26 TAC §746.613(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: One play area had exposed medal wires on the playground.     There were two screws protruding out of blue storage building.     There was a red tunnel that was no longer screwed to the structure, posing a hazard.     The school aged bathroom's toilet paper dispenser was falling off of the wall, exposing a screw.    Note: The wires, screws, and tunnel were removed from the play areas.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers -  24 Annual Training: One personnel file evaluated lacked 2 hours of annual training. Another personnel file evaluated lacked 21 hours of annual training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers -  24 Annual Training (26 TAC §746.1301(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: Based on information gathered during a DFPS investigation, the operation failed to notify Child Care Regulation that an infant child had vomited a foreign object with blood.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries: Based on information gathered during a DFPS investigation, the operation failed to timely notify a parent that their infant child had vomited a foreign object with blood, which prevented the child from receiving medical attention. There were also scratches to the child's throat.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries (26 TAC §746.307(c))

occurrences.finding: Licensing must have access to records: Based on information gathered during a DFPS investigation, operation staff were unable provide records related to the investigation in a timely manner as they did not have access to them.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensing must have access to records (26 TAC §745.8417)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Bees were observed on one of the playgrounds where children were playing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: Operation allowed a person to be present at the operation before receiving notice from the CBCU regarding the person's eligibility.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures: The emergency preparedness plan did not have information in regards to how staff will evacuate children with limited mobility or who are under 24 months or how staff will continue to care for children until parents arrive.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(1))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual: Inspector observed one staff yanking a child by their arm to sit down.     Inspector also heard staff yelling at children more than once during the inspection. The director was present and also heard staff yelling at children.     Inspector also observed another staff placed one 3 yr. old child alone in time out for approximately 6-10 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: The director had 1 out of 30 annual training hours on file for 2020-2021.    One staff had 13 out of 24 annual hours for 2020-2021. Trainings missing but are not limited to are child maltreatment, and SIDS, Shaken Baby, and Early Brain Development.    One staff was missing training in child maltreatment, SIDS, Shaken Baby, and Early Brain Development, communicable diseases, administering medication, food allergies, building and premises safety, hazardous materials including blood borne pathogens, and emergency preparedness.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Inspector observed one staff playing with chalk on the sidewalk while children were playing outdoors.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Child-Care Center Must be Equipped with a Working Carbon Monoxide (CO) Detection System: The operation has two buildings and neither building had a carbon monoxide detector.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child-Care Center Must be Equipped with a Working Carbon Monoxide (CO) Detection System (26 TAC §746.5531)

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: The director and two staff did not have transportation training on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))
